title: Elastic-plastic behaviour and stored energy
concepts_taught: Distinguish the elastic limit from the limit of proportionality.
Interpret area under a force-extension graph as work done.
Determine elastic potential energy from graph area within the proportional limit.
Use elastic potential energy formulas within the proportional limit.
Connect graph area, spring constant and energy transfers in integrated problems.
skills_students_can_now_use: Explain and apply: understand and use the terms elastic deformation, plastic deformation and elastic limit
Explain and apply: understand that the area under the force–extension graph represents the work done
Explain and apply: determine the elastic potential energy of a material deformed within its limit of proportionality from the area under the force–extension graph 1 1
Explain and apply: recall and use EP = 2 Fx = 2 kx2 for a material deformed within its limit of proportionality
